_notes.formAction: The form has an empty action and does nothing until you set it. Put your Formspree/Basin/Getform endpoint in form.action here, then rebuild. See README step 4.
_notes.confirmation: Two paths, one panel. With JS the form posts via fetch and the confirmation is revealed in place — the visitor never leaves the page. Without JS (or if the form service insists on redirecting), the hidden _next field sends them to /contact/thank-you/, which renders the identical page with the confirmation already showing. Both read from this same "success" block, so they cannot drift apart.
